title: Human In The Loop Tonight
style: bass house anthem, 128 BPM, driving energy, responsible AI theme as dance floor anthem, chantable hook, heavy kick, male vocal close and confident, peak time energy, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
Bot made a call at 11pm
No one checked it — that's the problem
Bot made a call at 3am
Someone has to own it — that's the system
Human in the loop — always
Not sometimes — not on bad days
Always — every output — every claim
Human in the loop — that's the name

[CHORUS]
Human in the loop tonight
Human in the loop — do it right
Human in the loop tonight
Human in the loop — every time
Sign it — own it — log it — find it
Human in the loop tonight

[VERSE 2]
CoreyAI logs the incident
ZYNVAULT holds the evidence
Every failure documented
Every win — represented
You are the signature
Not the tool that signed it
You are the law
The only one who defined it

[DROP — repeat chant]
Human in the loop — tonight
Human in the loop — tonight
Human in the loop — ZYNTHIO
Human in the loop — let's go

[OUTRO]
Human. In. The loop. Tonight. Every night.
